title: LaLa-World: Scaling Latent World Models with Natural Language Actions
abstract: arXiv:2610.27851v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: This paper shows that JEPA-style latent world models (LWMs) can learn across diverse domains and data sources by adopting the language-conditioned interface of video generation models. We establish this approach as an effective and efficient basis for planning with imagination and downstream policy fine-tuning. To this end, we introduce LaLa-World, a Language-conditioned Latent World model that learns from simulation and robot trajectories together with broader image and video data. Two designs make this work. First, we describe both numerical actions and visual changes in language, enabling joint training of a single future predictor across heterogeneous datasets. Second, we build the predictor on a language model, allowing it to interpret language conditions while predicting future latent states. The resulting predictor achieves higher average MPC planning performance than existing LWMs trained separately for each domain or task. Add

translated_title: LaLa-World：基于自然语言动作扩展潜在世界模型
translated_abstract: 本文表明，JEPA风格的潜在世界模型（LWM）可以通过采用视频生成模型的语言条件接口，实现跨多样化领域和数据源的学习。我们将这一方法确立为基于想象进行规划以及下游策略微调的有效且高效的基础。为此，我们提出了LaLa-World，一个语言条件潜在世界模型，它从仿真和机器人轨迹以及更广泛的图像和视频数据中学习。两个关键设计使这一工作成为可能：首先，我们用语言来描述数值动作和视觉变化，使得单一的未来预测器能够在异构数据集上进行联合训练；其次，我们将预测器构建在语言模型之上，使其在预测未来潜在状态的同时能够理解语言条件。由此得到的预测器相比针对每个领域或任务单独训练的现有LWM，实现了更高的平均MPC规划性能。
tldr: LaLa-World通过用语言统一描述动作与视觉变化、并将未来预测器构建于语言模型之上，使单个潜在世界模型能够跨仿真、机器人、图像和视频等异构数据进行联合训练，在MPC规划性能上超越了针对单一领域或任务训练的现有模型。
